fd2eca72de161466.description: Responsible for promoting and selling the company’s products or services to existing and potential customers. The role involves building strong customer relationships, understanding customer needs, achieving sales targets, and providing professional support throughout the sales process. Key Responsibilities: Present and promote products or services to customers in a professional manner. Achieve assigned sales targets and objectives. Identify and develop new business opportunities. Maintain strong relationships with existing customers. Prepare quotations and follow up on sales opportunities. Handle customer inquiries and provide suitable solutions. Monitor market trends and competitor activities. Prepare regular sales reports and updates.

fdae69bc64c52dda.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Specialist, Supplier Park Financial Controlling to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for the financial planning, analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and spending control for the Supplier Park Project. The specialist will also be responsible for developing financial reports. Key Responsibilities Report to the Manufacturing Controller on the CAPEX and Investment control process. Control and report CAPEX commitment, payment, balance to commit, and balance to pay to operating areas. Report cash flow spending projections to treasury and related areas. Ensure the accuracy and robustness of financial control tools, including ERP systems and Excel. Track purchasing requisitions by performing necessary entries and controls in the ERP System to ensure CAPEX budget adherence. Support meetings with Supplier Operations team members to develop forecasts for project plan deviations and mitigation strategies. Relationship Management Provide direct support to the Controller Assistant Manager. Act as a gatekeeper for CAPEX, Construction, and Facilities Investments inputs. Advise co-workers and stakeholders on any financial changes affecting the business. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to lead and adapt to continuous changes and challenges. Initiative to introduce process improvements. Resilience and a multi-tasking mindset. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on financial controlling within the Supplier Park Project at CEER.

fdb262990a75398e.description: About the Role Marouf Café (Mashhoor Food Company) is seeking a Graphic Designer & Photographer to join its marketing team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves creating visual content for various marketing channels, focusing on food and beverage products. Key Responsibilities Design creative content for social media, advertisements, promotions, and marketing campaigns. Capture high-quality photos and videos of coffee, food, products, and café locations. Create engaging Instagram Reels, Stories, and promotional videos. Edit and retouch photos and videos to maintain high-quality brand standards. Develop marketing materials, menus, packaging designs, and in-store promotional materials. Plan and execute product photoshoots and content creation sessions. Maintain consistent brand identity across all digital and printed materials. Collaborate with the marketing and operations teams on campaigns and product launches. Manage and organize the company's photo and video content library. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience in graphic design, photography, and video editing. Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, and Premiere Pro. Strong photography and videography skills, particularly in food and beverage. Experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok, and other social media platforms. A portfolio of previous work is required. Required Skills Creative mindset with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Experience in the F&B or hospitality industry is preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates within the marketing team of Marouf Café, a part of Mashhoor Food Company. The position is full-time.

fdd431e707991a64.description: About Noble Horizon and Art of Cardz Noble Horizon is expanding its operations in Saudi Arabia with the introduction of Art of Cardz (AOC) in Riyadh. AOC is a specialized retail concept focused on Trading Card Games (TCG), collectibles, and hobbies. This initiative integrates retail, e-commerce, trading cards, graded collectibles, accessories, organized play, and community engagement. Through AOC Riyadh, Noble Horizon aims to establish a destination for collectors, players, and TCG enthusiasts, supported by a professionally managed retail operation. Role Overview: Sales Associate Noble Horizon is seeking a Sales Associate to join the AOC team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and involves contributing to the daily operations and growth of the new business. The Sales Associate will play a key role in customer interaction, store maintenance, and supporting various retail activities. Key Responsibilities Maintain punctuality and uphold a professional work ethic. Adhere to established processes and procedures for daily operations. Coordinate store opening and closing procedures, ensuring assigned areas are clean and prepared. Assist customers with product knowledge, particularly for Pokémon, One Piece, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and other TCG products. Process sales transactions accurately using the POS system, including cash, card, and digital payments. Replenish product displays and ensure visual merchandising standards are met. Assist with pricing and re-pricing products using TCG-approved tools. Support the Storekeeper with monthly inventory counts. Maintain tidiness on the sales floor and in the trading cave, including restocking and ensuring presentable snack and cashier areas. Support the execution of in-store events, weekend tournaments, and special campaigns. Ensure proper cash handling procedures and end-of-day cash reconciliation. Inform management of key community developments and requirements from the TCG community. Support social media management and content creation as needed. Perform additional business-related duties as assigned. Wear the designated AOC uniform during working hours. Educational and Qualification Requirements High school diploma or equivalent (required). Experience in retail or customer service (preferred). Passion for TCG products (strong advantage). Basic proficiency in POS systems and mobile applications. Work Environment and Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis. The Sales Associate will work within the Art of Cardz retail environment, engaging directly with customers and supporting a community-focused business. Application Process Candidates interested in contributing to the growth of this new business are encouraged to apply.

fded3b466177c75a.description: About the Role National Guard Health Affairs (NGHA) is seeking an Assistant Consultant Plastic Surgery to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is governed by the responsibilities outlined in the Medical Staff Bylaws and focuses on providing and promoting a high standard of quality in plastic surgery surgical care. Key Responsibilities Operate in the operating room within approved privileges. Maintain presence in the working vicinity during normal working hours and be available for contact while in town. Work under the direct supervision of a consultant and the Section Head, Division of Plastic Surgery. Carry out assigned specific duties within the Division of Plastic Surgery with restricted responsibilities as requested by the immediate senior and approved by the Section Head. Participate actively in the training and education of junior staff. Attend and contribute to all plastic surgery division academic activities and research initiatives. Attend and participate in all division meetings and Department of Surgery staff meetings. Be actively involved in the ongoing quality management program. During on-call periods, manage all admissions and discharges in the Emergency Room. Meet the Continuing Medical Education (CME) requirements of Saudi specialization. Ensure proper Travel Request Authorization (TRA) is approved by the Chairman before taking leave. Maintain a collaborative and supportive teamwork environment within the Division of Plastic Surgery. Perform other job-related duties as assigned by senior staff. Scope of Practice The Assistant Consultant Plastic Surgery is allowed certain aspects of primary care responsibilities within approved privileges. These responsibilities are defined and supervised by a senior consultant and approved by the Section Head, Division of Plastic Surgery. This role does not include admission privileges. Qualifications and Requirements Graduation from a medical school recognized by NGHA. Successful completion of a structured, accredited residency training program in Plastic Surgery acceptable to NGHA. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh and requires a commitment to teamwork and adherence to established medical bylaws and quality management programs within the National Guard Health Affairs.

fd0a4ce342b44d89.description: About the Role Elliott Group is seeking a Workshop Mechanic (Turbomachinery) to join their team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This full-time permanent position involves recommending and implementing repairs for various industrial and rotating equipment, including compressors and turbines. The role requires the ability to document, install, align, repair, and inspect rotating equipment safely and efficiently to meet customer needs. Key Responsibilities Promote safety and quality standards consistently. Work effectively within a team environment and with limited supervision. Maintain a clean and organized work area. Conduct all interactions with internal and external customers in a professional manner. Read and comprehend drawings, sketches, work scopes, and verbal instructions. Utilize appropriate equipment, tooling, drawings, procedures, and documentation to perform primary functions. Alter and overhaul rotors, turbines, disc and blade holders, shafts, sleeves, gears, couplings, and other equipment as required. Set up all necessary equipment to complete jobs. Measure and record critical clearances and dimensions on turbines, compressors, and other equipment accurately. Understand and process documentation related to turbomachinery, such as inspection reports, photo logs, and hold tags. Help train other hourly employees in repair processes and procedures. Ensure continuity across work shifts by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and ongoing needs. Take ownership of work performance and stay updated on job knowledge and skill development. Required Skills and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in industrial and rotating equipment repair. Ability to document, erect, alter, install, align, repair, replace, disassemble, reassemble, move, and inspect most rotating equipment. Advanced knowledge and accuracy in using various measuring devices, including micrometers, indicators, calipers, and gauges. Ability to pass the annual dimensional inspection test. Advanced knowledge of lifting, rigging, crane, and forklift operations. Ability to plan and oversee repairs with limited supervision. Capability to assist in training other employees. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time permanent position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working in a workshop setting, collaborating with a team, and adhering to strict safety and quality protocols.

fd20ff76154d7465.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة الماء الاحمر لهندسة المشاريع عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل وتوزيع المهام وتقييم الأداء وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتصميم برامج تدريبية متخصصة لتنمية مهاراتهم. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد الخطط والبرامج التشغيلية. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة الفريق وتوزيع المهام. القدرة على تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وإجراءات تنفيذها. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة. عن الشركة شركة الماء الاحمر لهندسة المشاريع هي شركة متخصصة في مجال الهندسة والمشاريع، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها التشغيلية وتطوير أعمالها. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

fd5d7b0eb816f3fc.description: We are seeking a qualified Civil Site Engineer with 2–3 years of experience in finishing works, stone and marble façades, and aluminum cladding to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supervising daily site activities, coordinating with subcontractors and project teams, reviewing engineering drawings, monitoring work progress, and ensuring that all activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements. The candidate should have a bachelor's degree in civil engineering, practical experience in finishing and façade projects, and the ability to identify and resolve site-related technical issues. Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills are essential. Applicants must be Saudi nationals only and willing to work at project sites. Saudi Nationals Only. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering. 2–3 years of relevant experience in finishing and façade works. Experience in stone, marble, and cladding installation. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings. Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to work at project sites.

fd5f688bbad6b5a6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كيانات المتحدة عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق، بما في ذلك الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، بالإضافة إلى التصاميم والأثاث. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق بكفاءة. فهم قوي لقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل تقع الوظيفة في منطقة الجوف، في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن.

Be aware of possible situations where guests are not able to safely participate in an activity and inform supervisor/manager. fde994a6d4f0d3cd.description: As our Cybersecurity & Compliance Executive, you ll translate KSA-specific regulations (NCA, SAMA, PDPL) into actionable policies, partner with Tech teams to embed security controls and ensure every event and system launch meets the highest standards of data protection, risk management, and regulatory adherence. Key Responsibilities Regulatory Compliance Lead PDPL data-privacy readiness; coordinate with Legal for approvals. Help maintain documentation for PDPL, SAMA CSF, and NCA control checklists. Manage compliance with SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, NCA controls, and CITC guidelines. Prepare and share required security reports for each event with the Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA). Maintain audit trails and evidence packs to demonstrate compliance with internal and external audits, NCA and other regulatory controls. Vulnerability and Risk Management Run scheduled vulnerability assessments across all digital platforms (web, mobile, API). Work closely with platform owners, development, and ops teams to prioritize, track, and verify remediation of identified findings. Security Operations & Incident Response Oversee daily Security Information and Event Management monitoring, triage alerts, and threat intelligence feeds. Develop, test, and execute Incident Response Plans (IRP) and run tabletop exercises. Coordinate breach investigations and post-incident reports. Technical Architecture & Controls Advise on secure network, cloud (AWS/Azure), and identity architectures. Specify, deploy, and tune security tools: firewalls, IDS/IPS, DLP, EDR, vulnerability scanners. Policy & Process Maintenance Create and Update necessary policy documents and Standard Operating Procedures. Vendor & Tool Coordination Liaise with platform and tool providers to schedule maintenance windows or updates. Verify delivery of agreed security reporting (e.g., monthly vulnerability reports). Training & Awareness Build and deliver security awareness and phishing-simulation programs for all employees and event staff. Measure program effectiveness and iterate to drive cultural lift. Reporting Management Produce monthly dashboards on security posture, compliance status, and incident metrics for leadership. Liaise with internal teams (Tech, Legal, Operations) and external vendors to ensure consistent security integration.Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related discipline. Experience 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity roles, with a minimum of 2 years of closely operating within the Saudi regulatory environment. Deep knowledge of SAMA CSF, NCA controls, PDPL requirements, and KSA data-privacy laws. Basic project coordination skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining attention to detail. Comfortable adapting to a fast-paced environment and adjusting to changing priorities. Good communication and interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with project management tools and experience with event tech platforms is a plus. Experience working in the events and/or media industry is a plus. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related discipline. Experience 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity roles, with a minimum of 2 years of closely operating within the Saudi regulatory environment. Deep knowledge of SAMA CSF, NCA controls, PDPL requirements, and KSA data-privacy laws. Basic project coordination skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining attention to detail. Comfortable adapting to a fast-paced environment and adjusting to changing priorities. Good communication and interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with project management tools and experience with event tech platforms is a plus. Experience working in the events and/or media industry is a plus.

fd0a356a16c281c2.description: About the Role Discovered MENA is partnering with a fast-growing Riyadh studio, backed by a major global gaming group, to hire a founding Localization Engineer. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on building a dedicated Arabic-first localization capability from the ground up. The Localization Engineer will work directly with Unity and game teams to integrate Arabic as a core language within game titles. Role Context and Impact This position involves hands-on engineering to establish a robust localization pipeline. The role requires designing and implementing systems, writing production-grade code, and ensuring these systems perform under real production loads. The objective is to enhance the integration of Arabic language in games, moving beyond current practices where Arabic is often an afterthought in the industry. Key Responsibilities Developing the localization engineering stack within Unity from scratch. Ensuring proper handling of Arabic text, including RTL and bidirectional support, shaping, ligatures, font fallback, text expansion, and layout mirroring. Establishing the localization pipeline, covering string extraction and management, integration into builds, automated checks, and pseudo-localization. Collaborating with QA to maintain quality at scale and identify issues early. Defining the tooling and standards for game teams to build against. Qualifications and Requirements Strong Unity and C# engineering skills with experience in shipping games. Ability to write and demonstrate real, production-grade code. Experience in building or owning localization, text rendering, or tooling systems, with a preference for experience in RTL and Arabic contexts. Understanding of text pipelines, build integration, automation, and QA collaboration. Consideration for performance, memory, and scalability in engineering solutions. Readiness to relocate to Riyadh. Additional Skills Arabic language skills and prior MENA localization experience are considered beneficial but are not mandatory for this role. fd1ec1b34caaa8cd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الجمعية الخيرية لإكرام المسنين عن منسق فعاليات للانضمام إلى فريقها في بلجرشي، الباحة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ المراسم والفعاليات الرسمية، وتنسيق الخدمات اللوجستية، وضمان تجربة سلسة للزوار والضيوف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ المراسم والفعاليات الرسمية بما يتوافق مع الأعراف المتبعة. تخطيط الخدمات اللوجستية والتنسيق الفعال مع المضيفين والزوار. مرافقة الضيوف القادمين وضمان سير زياراتهم على أكمل وجه. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية. المهام التفصيلية المشاركة في تخطيط الفعاليات والمراسم الرسمية وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. إعداد وترتيب مواعيد وجداول الزيارات للضيوف، وتقديم المساعدة في تنظيم الأمور اللوجستية والعروض والوسائل الترفيهية. تنفيذ البرامج التفصيلية للزيارات الرسمية، ومعالجة أي تأخيرات غير متوقعة. التنسيق مع الصحافة ووسائل الإعلام لتغطية الفعاليات. التعاون والتواصل مع الجهات والمكاتب المتخصصة لضمان جودة المراسم والزيارات. توثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التخطيط والتنسيق الفعال للفعاليات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في بلجرشي، الباحة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

fd26b7f09733ba41.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الأسنان عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم أطباء الأسنان في مهامهم اليومية، وضمان بيئة عمل منظمة ومعقمة، وتقديم رعاية ممتازة للمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، مع توثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في ملفاتهم. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان بشكل دوري. تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان والمعدات الأخرى لضمان جاهزيتها للعمل. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة، بالإضافة إلى خلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء الإجراءات من خلال مناولته الأدوات والمواد وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل، وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق طبي. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والتعقيم في بيئة طبية. بيئة العمل يعمل مساعد طبيب الأسنان في مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الأسنان بمدينة تبوك، ضمن بيئة عيادة أسنان حديثة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في العيادة لدعم العمليات اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة.

fdf8047dea44925f.description: About MBRF and the Role MBRF is a company that impacts thousands of families globally by providing quality and innovation in food products. fd6bc440d3ea3313.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التحسين العالمية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تحليل عناصر المشروع، ووضع الخطط الزمنية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى إدارة التدفق النقدي وتحليل المخاطر. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل عناصر وفعاليات المشروع، وتحديد ارتباطاتها وترتيبها، ودراسة قيمة المشروع وحجمه، وإعداد برنامج زمني مفصل وترتيب الإجراءات. إعداد الموارد المادية والبشرية اللازمة لتنفيذ المشروع ومتابعة توفيرها في التوقيتات المناسبة. تطوير جدول تدفق نقدي يتناسب مع تسلسل تنفيذ الفعاليات والمراحل المختلفة للمشروع. مراجعة التنفيذ والتقدم الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالبرنامج المخطط، وإعداد البرامج المعدلة والمنقحة عند الحاجة، مع تطوير أساليب وتقنيات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة المشاريع، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل عناصر المشروع ووضع الخطط والبرامج الزمنية. مهارات في إعداد برامج التدفق النقدي وتحليل المخاطر المتوقعة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد ارتباطات وفعاليات المشروع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة الموارد والوقت. القدرة على مراجعة وتعديل مراحل التنفيذ وتطوير أساليب العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي إدارة المشاريع بدوام كامل في مقر شركة التحسين العالمية بالرياض. يساهم الدور في دعم المشاريع المختلفة للشركة من خلال التخطيط والمتابعة الفعالة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمزيد من التفاصيل حول عملية التوظيف.

Control and secure cash and cash equivalents in accordance with established cash handling policies and procedures. Organize, secure, and maintain all files and records, adhering to document retention and confidentiality policies. fd8ff4938665a65d.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a System Integration Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading and overseeing the integration of all railway systems, including infrastructure, stations, and operational interfaces for a major railway project. The manager will ensure seamless coordination and alignment across all systems and disciplines to deliver a safe, efficient, reliable, and operationally ready railway in line with project objectives and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the Systems Integration Management Plan and integration strategy for the project. Lead the coordination and integration of all railway systems, including signalling, communications, traction power, SCADA, OCC, rolling stock, platform systems, depot systems, and associated infrastructure. Manage system interfaces between rail systems, civil infrastructure, stations, depots, and operational environments. Establish and maintain system interface registers, ensuring all interfaces are identified, tracked, coordinated, and resolved. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure fully integrated and consistent system design outputs across all project stages. Ensure effective integration between infrastructure, stations, operational systems, and external interfaces, including airport-related systems where applicable. Coordinate interfaces with operational stakeholders, authorities, operators, contractors, and specialist system providers. Facilitate systems integration workshops, technical coordination meetings, and interface resolution sessions. Support Systems Engineering activities, including requirements management, interface management, verification, validation, and traceability processes. Coordinate with Configuration and Requirements Management teams to ensure alignment and integration across all systems. Identify and manage integration risks and interface conflicts, and implement mitigation strategies. Lead system integration reviews to ensure all interfaces and operational requirements are properly addressed and resolved. Monitor integration progress and support timely resolution of technical and operational issues. Support testing and commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, SIT, integrated testing, trial operations, and operational readiness activities. Ensure compliance with project requirements, railway standards, safety requirements, and operational objectives. Support construction and delivery teams by ensuring clear understanding and management of system interfaces during implementation. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in system integration, preferably within railway projects. Commitment to Sustainability Egis is committed to environmental responsibility. In every project, the company considers the long-term impact and strives to shape a better future for communities globally. This commitment is further supported by the Egis Foundation, which funds initiatives addressing the climate crisis and promotes educational and social programs for a sustainable world. Diversity and Inclusion Egis is an Equal Opportunities employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce. Applications are welcomed from all backgrounds, irrespective of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, or any other protected characteristic. Applications are assessed based on experience, essential and desirable criteria, and suitability for the role. Egis values individual contributions, fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive work environment.

fdb44ed9dc192c56.description: About the Role ISG (مدارس المجموعة العالمية) is seeking a Substitute Teacher for American School Dhahran (ASD) in the Eastern region, specifically in Al Khobar and Dhahran. fdc155255929d517.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مهندس إلكترونيات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية، وضمان أدائها الأمثل وتدريب المستخدمين عليها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب، بما في ذلك التشغيل التجريبي والضبط. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الإلكترونية لضمان الاستخدام الفعال. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إجراء الفحوص اللازمة بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة الأداء وسلامة التشغيل. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الإلكترونية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الإلكترونيات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة الإلكترونيات. القدرة على إعداد خطط التركيب والصيانة للأجهزة الإلكترونية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الإصلاحات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية وتشخيصية ممتازة. القدرة على تدريب المستخدمين وتقديم الدعم الفني. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق الفني. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الإلكترونيات بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تقديم حلول صيانة وتشغيل عالية الجودة. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.

fdcb712b7cc9c007.company_name: شركة بيوت أجمل للديكور و التصميم الداخلي
fdcb712b7cc9c007.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيوت أجمل للديكور والتصميم الداخلي عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء، فهم احتياجاتهم، وإدارة عملية المبيعات والمشاريع من البداية وحتى التسليم النهائي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء والتواصل الفعال معهم لفهم احتياجاتهم ومتطلباتهم بدقة. تقديم خدمات التصميم الداخلي وشرح تفاصيل الخدمات والعروض المتاحة للعملاء. متابعة العملاء وتحويل الاستفسارات الأولية إلى فرص مبيعات وعقود فعلية. إعداد عقود المبيعات الخاصة بالتصميم والتنفيذ، والتأكد من استكمال جميع البيانات المطلوبة بدقة. رفع وحفظ جميع معلومات وبيانات العملاء والعقود والمستندات في نظام التخزين السحابي الخاص بالشركة. التواصل المستمر مع العملاء عبر الهاتف المخصص للشركة لمتابعة طلباتهم واستفساراتهم. التنسيق الفعال مع العملاء والمنفذين لضمان سير العمل وفق المتطلبات المتفق عليها والجداول الزمنية المحددة. متابعة مراحل تنفيذ المشروع المختلفة والتأكد من معالجة أي ملاحظات أو تعديلات بالتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية. متابعة المشروع حتى اكتماله التام والتأكد من تسليمه للعميل بالشكل المطلوب وبأعلى معايير الجودة. التأكد من إغلاق المشروع بشكل كامل واستكمال جميع المستندات والبيانات الخاصة به. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم حلول تصميمية مبتكرة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع ومتابعتها حتى التسليم. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في خدمة العملاء والمبيعات. القدرة على إعداد العقود والمستندات بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التصميم الداخلي في بيئة عمل ديناميكية في الرياض، ضمن فريق شركة بيوت أجمل للديكور والتصميم الداخلي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والمنفذين لضمان سير المشاريع بسلاسة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن يجدون في أنفسهم الكفاءة والخبرة المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة.

fdeb525c3e436a64.description: About Lucid Motors Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation. The company develops award-winning vehicles based on proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, aiming to combine performance, sustainability, design, and engineering. Lucid achieves this through deep vertical integration, with in-house design, engineering, and production across its global facilities. The Role of Service Advisor Lucid Motors is seeking a Service Advisor for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role involves facilitating service center operations by managing customer interactions, coordinating resources, and ensuring targets for customer satisfaction, customer retention, and productivity are met in accordance with company procedures and standards. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct pre-acceptance vehicle inspections, including checking for body damage, valuables, and accessories, and document findings with the customer. Support the achievement of Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and customer retention goals through professional customer engagement. Coordinate with Chief Technicians on job assignments, diagnostics, and final vehicle inspections to ensure repairs meet customer expectations. Promote a 'Guest Centric' and 'Fix-It-Right' mindset within the service team. Coordinate with the Parts Department to ensure the availability of spare parts and timely vehicle delivery. Follow up on service complaints, issues, and concerns, escalating them to the Workshop Floor Manager when necessary. Monitor service progress and maintain communication with customers throughout the repair process. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant service advisor role. Demonstrated ability to manage customer interactions effectively. Experience coordinating manpower and facilities in a service environment. Strong understanding of customer satisfaction and retention principles. Compensation and Benefits Lucid offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays; paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours of paid time off, while salaried/exempt employees accrue up to 160 hours. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program, with awards determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results.

fd0d6e4c439acdaa.description: Job description A search is being conducted for a talented interior design intern to be part of our team at the private accounting firm located in Al Ghadir, Riyadh. Ability to work within a team and collaborate with colleagues. Strong communication skills with the ability to understand client needs. Time management skills and effective task organization. Basic understanding of colors and materials used in interior design. Attention to detail and ability to present appealing design ideas.

fd89e8e2e2603f5a.description: Position: Automation Engineer Location: Factory – Saudi Arabia ( Sudair ) Job Type: Full-time Reporting to: Maintenance Manager Job Summary To support the Maintenance and Engineering teams in maintaining troubleshooting and improving industrial automation systems and production equipment. The Automation Engineer will develop practical experience in PLC, HMI, VFD, sensors, instrumentation, electrical control systems, and industrial networks , while supporting preventive maintenance and continuous improvement activities. Key Responsibilities Support troubleshooting of PLC, HMI, VFD, servo drives, sensors, and control systems . Assist senior engineers and technicians during machine breakdowns and corrective maintenance. Support preventive maintenance activities for automation and control equipment. Assist with PLC and HMI program backups , documentation, and version control. Monitor and maintain automation-related parameters and machine settings. Support troubleshooting communication issues between PLCs, HMIs, drives, and field devices. Assist in identifying recurring automation failures and participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) . Support machine commissioning, testing, and modification activities. Assist with automation improvement projects aimed at improving OEE, reliability, and machine performance . Maintain updated records of PLC/HMI programs, electrical drawings, parameters, and technical documentation. Support interaction with OEMs and external suppliers during technical troubleshooting. Participate in machine inspections and identify potential automation-related improvement opportunities. Follow all LOTO, electrical safety, and factory safety procedures . Provide technical support to maintenance technicians when required. Learn and apply the factory's CMMS/EAM system for maintenance activities and equipment history. Technical Areas to Develop The engineer will be expected to develop competency in: PLC programming and troubleshooting HMI systems VFDs and servo drives Industrial sensors and instrumentation Pneumatic control systems Electrical control panels Industrial communication networks SCADA systems Machine safety systems PLC/HMI software backup and restoration Basic electrical drawings and control schematics CMMS/EAM systems Preferred PLC Platforms Knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Siemens Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Schneider Required Skills Basic understanding of PLC and automation principles. Basic knowledge of electrical circuits and control systems. Ability to read electrical/control diagrams. Basic troubleshooting and analytical skills. Good understanding of sensors, motors, VFDs, and industrial equipment. Good computer skills. Good communication and teamwork skills. Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and support breakdowns when required. Strong interest in learning industrial automation and maintenance. Behavioral Competencies Problem-solving mindset Continuous learning Teamwork and collaboration Attention to detail Safety awareness Accountability Communication skills Ability to work under pressure Proactive approach First-Year Development Objectives During the first year, the engineer should progressively become able to: Troubleshoot basic PLC/HMI faults independently. Perform PLC/HMI backups and maintain software records. Troubleshoot basic VFD and sensor-related failures. Read and understand electrical control drawings. Support machine commissioning and modification activities. Participate in RCA for recurring automation failures. Understand the factory's major production and packaging lines. Use the CMMS/EAM system correctly. Develop basic PLC/HMI programming skills. Support automation improvement projects that contribute to downtime reduction and OEE improvement . Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Automation-related breakdown response time Completion of PLC/HMI backup activities Preventive maintenance compliance Number of recurring automation/system failures reduced Automation improvement projects completed Reduction in automation-related downtime CMMS/EAM data accuracy Completion of assigned training and competency development Required Qualifications Diploma or bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control Engineering , or a related field. Fresh graduate or 2 years of experience in industrial environments. Internship experience in manufacturing, automation, electrical systems, or maintenance is preferred.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. This role sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, customer engagement, and delivery excellence. You will be responsible for driving services bookings growth while ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of complex engagements. Reporting to the Regional Services Leader, you will partner closely with Enterprise & Public Sector Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and Customer Success to define and execute tailored services strategies that accelerate time to value and drive long-term adoption of Elastic solutions. Provide governance oversight for strategic accounts, managing escalations and aligning Sales, Delivery, and Customer Success stakeholders. Identify and mitigate risks, facilitate steering meetings, and ensure structured reporting and change management. Collaborate effectively within a matrixed organization across Sales, Delivery, Operations, and Partner teams. What You Bring: 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, program delivery, or pre-sales roles within enterprise technology environments. Demonstrated experience working with Enterprise & Public Sector organizations. Proven commercial ownership of services bookings targets, including forecasting and complex contract negotiations. Strong background in delivering technology solutions in search, observability, analytics, or security domains. Experience managing multiple concurrent engagements with governance and risk oversight responsibilities. Fluency in Arabic and English required. Saudi Arabian Citizenship is essential for this role. Willingness to travel up to 50% (and occasionally internationally). Bonus Points: Familiarity with Elasticsearch and related technologies (Linux, NoSQL, distributed systems). PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum Master certification. Experience as a billable consultant or project manager. Ability to obtain security clearance if required. Build and convert a qualified pipeline with upstream, midstream, downstream, and industrial/manufacturing clients, including national oil companies and tier-one industrial accounts. Excellent stakeholder management across technical, operational, and executive audiences. The Project Director will be responsible for driving excellence in project execution while fostering innovation, aligning all initiatives with the company’s strategic objectives. Key Duties & Responsibilities: • Establish and manage the Project Management Office (PMO), including its strategy, structure, governance, and processes. • Oversee the Innovation Department, leading initiatives for organizational transformation, exploring emerging technologies, and embedding innovative solutions. • Develop and implement standardized project and innovation methodologies, tools, and frameworks to ensure efficiency and consistency. • Collaborate with executive leadership and government stakeholders to align projects and innovation initiatives with national priorities. • Lead and mentor project managers and innovation teams, building a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous development. • Oversee the full lifecycle of projects and innovation initiatives, from ideation to implementation and closure, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and timelines. • Establish governance structures such as Steering Committees and Innovation Boards to enable transparent decision-making. • Implement effective risk management practices across projects and innovation programs, ensuring proactive mitigation and contingency planning. • Promote a culture of innovation within the organization, encouraging creativity and adoption of new solutions to improve performance and services. • Monitor performance using KPIs for both projects and innovation, and provide regular reporting to senior management and key stakeholders. • Represent the organization in front of government stakeholders and global consulting partners to enhance its role as a key contributor to national transformation. • Collaborate with senior executives and stakeholders to align project objectives with the company's strategic goals and ensure effective prioritization of projects. Qualifications & Experience: • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). • Minimum of 10–12 years of experience in managing complex programs and projects, with proven experience in government projects and national transformation initiatives. • Previous experience working with top-tier global consulting firms such as PwC, KPMG, EY, or Deloitte. • Solid background in innovation management and adoption of emerging technologies. • Professional certification in project management (PMP, PgMP) and/or innovation (e.g., Design Thinking, Innovation Management) is highly desirable. • Proficiency in project and innovation management tools and software. • Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels. • Work location will be between Jeddah and Riyadh, depending on business needs.
